### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A01 was followed by A04 in about 50% of its outgoing transitions, by A03 in about 29%, and by A02 in about 22%; in the later window, A01 is followed by A04 in 100% of observed transitions. [DIR001]
- In the earlier window, A04 was followed by A01 in about 50%, A02 in about 26%, and A03 in about 24%; in the later window, A04 is followed by A03 in about 53% and A02 in about 47%, and never by A01. [DIR002]
- In the earlier window, A06 was followed by A01 in about 50% and A04 in about 50%; in the later window, A06 is followed by A01 in 100%. [DIR003]
- A01 and A04 co-occur in all traces in both windows. Earlier, A01 appeared before A04 in about 25% of traces, A04 before A01 in about 28%, and they were interleaved/repeated in about 47%; later, A01 appears before A04 in about 58%, interleaved/repeated in about 42%, and A04 before A01 never occurs. [REL001]
- A01's relative position moved earlier (mean from about 0.40 to 0.29; median from about 0.45 to 0), while A04's relative position moved later (mean from about 0.39 to 0.50; lower quartile from 0 to about 0.27). [POS001, POS002]
- The distance between A01 and A04 changed: A01-to-A04 became more often immediate (lag 1 from about 30% to 53% of pairs), while A04-to-A01 became no longer immediate (lag 1 from about 31% to 0, lag 4 from about 8% to 47%). [LAG004, LAG008]
- Other lag shifts: A01-to-A03 changed from a lag-1/lag-2 mix to always lag 2; A04-to-A03 changed from a lag-1/lag-2 mix to always lag 1; A01-to-A02 and A04-to-A02 shifted toward lag 2 and lag 1 respectively. [LAG003, LAG010, LAG002, LAG009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a hypothesis that the ordering between A01 and A04 changed: in the earlier window A01 and A04 could appear in either order or interleaved, while in the later window A01 consistently precedes A04, with A01 moving earlier, A04 moving later, and the direct successor relations changing accordingly (A01 now always leads to A04; A04 no longer leads to A01). This is supported by direct relational, positional, and lag evidence. The control-flow evidence is extensive (20 items vs 0.13 expected by chance), so the difference is not a chance artifact. [REL001, POS001, POS002, DIR001, DIR002, LAG004, LAG008, screening]

Other differences: A06's successor changed from a mix of A01 and A04 to only A01. [DIR003] The evidence cannot rule out that the later window simply did not sample rare cases where A04 still precedes A01, but the consistency of the relational and positional evidence makes that unlikely.
